options.name: Skillet Chicken with Spinach and Feta
options.why: uses the most of what you have
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pan and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes per side, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken, set aside.
Add onion to the same pan and cook until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Return chicken to pan, sprinkle feta over top, toss briefly to combine and serve.

options.name: Baked Chicken and Rice with Spinach
options.why: hands-off cooking while you do other things
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss rice, onion, oil, salt and pepper in a baking dish, spread evenly.
Place chicken thighs on top, season with salt and pepper.
Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes.
Uncover, stir in spinach, and bake 10 more minutes until chicken reaches 165°F internally and rice is tender.
Sprinkle feta over the top before serving.

options.name: Spinach Feta Egg Scramble Bowl
options.why: fastest of the three, ready before you know it
steps: Heat oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, 1 minute.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour into pan.
Scramble gently until eggs are just set with no runny liquid remaining, about 3 minutes.
Stir in feta off the heat and serve.

options.name: Microwave Chicken Rice Bowl with Feta
options.why: fastest way to use your rice and chicken together
steps: Cook rice ahead or use leftover cooked rice.
Chop cooked chicken thigh into bite-size pieces; chicken should read 165°F if reheating raw meat.
Put rice, chicken and spinach in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave on high 2 minutes, stir, then 1 more minute until spinach wilts and everything is hot.
Drizzle with olive oil, top with feta, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

options.name: Egg and Onion Scramble with Feta
options.why: quickest protein hit with almost no prep
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook 2 minutes until soft.
Crack eggs into the pan and scramble gently until just set, about 3 minutes; eggs should reach 160°F or no longer look runny.
Remove from heat, stir in feta, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

options.name: No-Cook Chicken Spinach Rice Salad
options.why: no stove needed, great for using leftover cooked chicken and rice fast
steps: In a bowl, combine cooled cooked rice, chicken, spinach and onion.
Add feta and drizzle with olive oil.
Toss everything together well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve cold or at room temperature.

options.name: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Feta Rice Pilaf
options.why: grilled protein portion is the biggest of the three
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper and a little olive oil.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile cook rice in water per package directions until tender.
Sauté onion in olive oil until soft, stir in spinach until wilted.
Fold spinach and onion mixture and feta into cooked rice.
Slice grilled chicken and serve over the rice pilaf.

options.name: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Spinach Feta Rice
options.why: oven method lets the chicken portion stay large while it roasts hands-off
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken thighs with olive oil, salt and pepper, spread on sheet pan with sliced onion.
Roast 22-25 minutes until chicken reaches internal temperature of 165°F.
While chicken roasts, cook rice in water until tender.
Stir spinach into hot rice until wilted, then top with feta.
Serve roasted chicken thighs over the spinach feta rice.

options.name: Chicken and Egg Power Bowl with Spinach Feta
options.why: combines two protein sources for the biggest portion of the three
steps: Cook rice in water until tender.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté onion until soft.
Add diced chicken thighs, cook 8-10 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Push chicken to the side, scramble eggs in the same pan until fully set.
Stir in spinach until wilted, season with salt and pepper.
Serve chicken and egg mixture over rice, topped with feta.

options.name: Chicken and Spinach Fried Rice
options.why: uses up leftover-style rice and the chicken in one pan
steps: Heat oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook, stirring, until no longer pink and it reaches 165°F, about 6-7 minutes.
Push chicken aside, add onion and cook until soft, 3 minutes.
Push everything aside, pour in eggs and scramble until just set, 1-2 minutes.
Add rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Stir in spinach and soy sauce, cook until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

options.name: Chicken and Rice Soup with Spinach
options.why: a warm pot meal that uses everything on hand
steps: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and soften onion, about 4 minutes.
Add chicken thighs and broth, bring to a simmer.
Cook until chicken reaches 165°F, about 15 minutes, then remove and shred, returning it to the pot.
Add rice and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, ladle into bowls and top with feta.

options.name: Chicken Feta Rice Salad Wraps
options.why: no stove needed, quick lunch built from what you have
steps: In a bowl, combine shredded chicken, rice, spinach and onion.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Toss well to combine.
Crumble feta over the top and toss lightly.
Serve as is or spoon into a tortilla or wrap if you have one on hand.

options.name: Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs with Feta Crumble
options.why: crisps up the skin without heating the whole kitchen

ingredients.text: handful baby spinach, chopped, for serving

steps: Preheat air fryer to 380°F.
Rub chicken thighs with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Air fry 18-20 minutes, flipping once, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest 3 minutes, then top with crumbled feta and chopped spinach before serving.

options.name: Onion and Spinach Rice Soup with Egg Ribbons
options.why: warms you up and stretches the rice you have
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and soften the onion, about 5 minutes.
Add broth and rice, bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes until rice is tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Slowly drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring so they form thin ribbons; eggs should reach 160°F.
Season with salt and pepper, top with feta and serve.

options.name: Chilled Rice and Spinach Salad with Marinated Onions
options.why: no stove needed and ready to eat cold
steps: Soak the sliced onion in the lemon juice for 10 minutes to soften and mellow it.
In a bowl combine cooled rice, spinach and marinated onion with its juice.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss well.
Fold in feta, season with salt and pepper, and serve chilled.

options.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Garlic Salmon with Asparagus
options.why: uses the most of what you have
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Lay salmon and asparagus on a lined sheet pan.
Drizzle with oil, scatter garlic, top with lemon slices, season with salt and pepper.
Roast 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes and reaches 145°F internal temperature and asparagus is tender.

options.name: Garlic Lemon Salmon Rice Bowl
options.why: balanced one-bowl meal using everything on hand
steps: Cook rice in a pot according to package amounts of water until tender.
Meanwhile, pan-sear salmon in a separate pan with oil and garlic, about 4 minutes per side, until it flakes and reaches 145°F internal temperature.
Steam or boil asparagus in a small pot until just tender, about 4 minutes.
Flake salmon over rice, add asparagus, drizzle with lemon juice, season and serve.

options.name: Grilled Lemon Garlic Salmon Skewers
options.why: fastest of the three and great use of the grill
steps: Toss salmon cubes and asparagus pieces with oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Thread onto skewers, alternating salmon and asparagus.
Grill over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, about 8-10 minutes until salmon flakes and reaches 145°F internal temperature.
Serve warm with extra lemon wedges.

options.name: Banana Blueberry Oatmeal Bowl
options.why: uses the most of what you have on hand
steps: Combine oats and milk in a small pot over medium heat.
Stir often and simmer about 6 to 8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Pour into a bowl and top with sliced banana and blueberries.
Drizzle honey over the top and serve warm.

options.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
options.why: no stove needed, ready fast
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer with half the banana, blueberries, and oats.
Repeat layers with remaining yogurt, fruit, and oats.
Drizzle honey on top and serve right away.

options.name: Baked Banana Oat Egg Cups
options.why: closest to your protein for the day
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, mashed banana, yogurt, honey, and cinnamon together.
Stir in oats and blueberries until combined.
Divide batter evenly among muffin cups.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until set and eggs reach 165°F.
Let cool a few minutes before removing from tin.

options.name: Crispy Chicken and Rice Bowl
options.why: uses the most of what you have on hand
steps: Cook rice in water per package until tender, about 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken, season with salt and pepper, cook 6-8 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Push chicken aside, add onion, pepper and garlic, cook 4-5 minutes until soft.
Stir everything together with the rice and serve hot.

options.name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato
options.why: hands-off cooking while you handle other things
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss sweet potato cubes with half the oil, salt and pepper, spread on a tray.
Roast sweet potato for 10 minutes, then add broccoli tossed with remaining oil.
Push vegetables aside, place salmon on the tray, season with salt and pepper.
Roast another 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Serve salmon alongside the roasted vegetables.

options.name: Black Bean and Feta Bowl
options.why: no stove needed, quick to put together
steps: Combine black beans, spinach, pepper and onion in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper, toss to combine.
Top with crumbled feta.
Serve with a dollop of greek yogurt on the side or mixed in.
